rows.text: The kitchen knife and Spices Supreme... I think I heard about that store before — over in Exalting Sanctum.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: If we want to find it, maybe we should ask some Luofu locals.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Can you wait a little moment? The master diviner will be here soon.
rows.speaker: Qingzu

rows.text: She's temporarily taken on the general's responsibilities. Before meeting you, she must make the current situation known and fortify public spirit. This is her first real test as a general — I hope she can get used to things quickly.
rows.speaker: Qingzu

rows.text: ...I don't think I can ever get used to this.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: *sigh* It's a pleasure to see you all here today.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Collating casualties and losses, dispatching forces to round up the remnants of the Disciples, submitting battle reports to the Six Charioteers... Now I know what Jing Yuan meant when he said "the highest throne faces the strongest winds."
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Master Diviner, have you summoned us here just to sigh and complain?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Of course not! On the contrary, I am eager to thank you all in my official capacity as acting general of the Luofu. Now that things have drawn to a conclusion, it is time to reward you.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Oooo! All those benefits that the general promised — they're finally here! Yippee!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Yes, the Astral Express has braved great evil for the Luofu. Your devotion is evident. After discussions with the Six Charioteers, you are henceforth sworn allies of the Luofu. Within the Luofu's jurisdiction, you are to be treated with the highest standard of diplomatic protocol.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: On behalf of the Astral Express, I would like to thank you, Master Diviner.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Think I need a reminder...
I remember.
Think I need a reminder...
I remember.
Wow, nothing tangible then, but at least it sounds pretty cool...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Now that thanks have been expressed, I still have something to discuss with you. Please, this way.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: The Ambrosial Arbor is dormant. Thanks to everyone's hard-fought battles, the Luofu is safe once more.
rows.speaker: Qingzu

rows.text: Before he left, the general told me to handle things at the Seat of Divine Foresight. Fortunately, now that victory has been achieved, the plans we prepared will never see the light of day. However...
rows.speaker: Qingzu

rows.text: Let's discuss Phantylia first...
Let's talk about the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus...
Let's discuss the Stellaron Hunters...
The general did order that if he were unable to return to duty, then the master diviner would take over his duties temporarily.
rows.speaker: Qingzu

rows.text: It appears that Phantylia was the mastermind behind it all. The Xianzhou warred with the Antimatter Legion in the past, and ever since we have kept a watchful eye on their movements.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Few could have foreseen the insidious tactics employed in the execution of their assaults. The Lord Ravager slithered in unnoticed, clandestinely plotting and machinating, and surreptitiously bestowed a Stellaron upon the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus. This heinous act instigated an uprising aimed at luring the Luofu into a perilous trap of self-destruction.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: The present danger posed by the Legion clearly demands a re-evaluation. We should proceed cautiously.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: When the Ambrosial Arbor was severed by the Reignbow Arbiter thousands of years ago, the Abundance became a taboo. Those within the Alchemy Commission — the original masters of the so-called "way of immortality" — were ruined at a stroke. The commission became a shadow of its former self.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Presumably, from that moment on, the seeds of discord for the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus had already been planted... Some of them were willing to work with the enemy, acquiring a Stellaron from the Antimatter Legion to try and revive {RUBY_B#Ambrosial Arbor}the Abundance{RUBY_E#}.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Hmm... They succeeded alright, but why would Phantylia's objective be to realize their wishes? Those traitors gained nothing — they betrayed the Xianzhou only to become sacrificial offerings in the Lord Ravager's grand scheme.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: The Stellaron Hunters? We know just as little. But in the Matrix of Prescience, I saw a prophecy that Kafka received from {RUBY_B#Elio}Destiny's Slave{RUBY_E#}. Elio foresaw all manner of possibilities for the Luofu...
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Based on what Kafka knows, and despite everything being under the control of Elio, that prophecy is indeed the most beneficial future for the Luofu. The Stellaron Hunters walked right into our trap, and even gifted allies — in the form of yourselves — to the Xianzhou... That might sound self-interested, but I hope the feeling is mutual.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Now that future has come true, the Xianzhou has discovered the Legion's intentions, and with everyone's help, has imposed a crushing defeat on Phantylia.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Is the general okay?
What do you plan on doing with the Ambrosial Arbor?
Fu Xuan seems to be handling things pretty well...
Alas, I'm no healer, I'm afraid I couldn't say.
rows.speaker: Qingzu

rows.text: I ordered a military doctor to provide the most comprehensive emergency treatment they could. The Alchemy Commission was caught up in the Sanctus Medicus conspiracy — it took a lot of work to find someone trustworthy enough to heal the general.
rows.speaker: Qingzu

rows.text: If we can help, don't hesitate to ask. I don't know much about medicine, but... there are lots of ways to seal wounds and prevent injuries from worsening.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Don't worry, long-life species are resilient and strong — the general will pull through. He's faced down situations a hundred times more dangerous than this.
rows.speaker: Qingzu

rows.text: What do we plan on doing... *sigh* Thousands of years ago, the Xianzhou Alliance was at its wit's end trying to deal with it. Today, nothing's changed.
rows.speaker: Qingzu

rows.text: The Arbor was resurrected. Aside from the Arbiter's Lux Arrow, I'm afraid that nothing can materially harm it. We might be able to suppress it with the help of the Vidyadhara, but with internal strife ravaging their ranks, I'm afraid it's a long shot...
rows.speaker: Qingzu

rows.text: If you can locate exactly where the Stellaron is within the Arbor, then the Express might be able to help out.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Thank you for your kind offer, Mr. Yang. But something as important and fundamental as the Ambrosial Arbor will require a meeting and deliberation from the Six Charioteers.
rows.speaker: Qingzu

rows.text: Better to wait until the master diviner has another twenty or thirty years under her belt.
rows.speaker: Qingzu

rows.text: Subduing the enemy is one of the most minor parts of a general's work. They have to meet with the Luofu's Six Charioteers and undergo Ten-Lords Commission inspections — all while dealing with the Xianzhou Alliance's top brass...
rows.speaker: Qingzu

rows.text: None of it is easy to navigate, but it's a daily responsibility. The crown of a general sits heavy on the head indeed.
rows.speaker: Qingzu

rows.text: I almost forgot — I need to gather data for the master diviner's draft report. Bye for now.
rows.speaker: Qingzu

rows.text: ...Seriously? Thanking us like that, and then immediately sending us on another mission?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It's not a mission. The Stellaron crisis, the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus rebellion, the Arbor's resurrection, not to mention the Antimatter Legion infiltrating the Luofu... All of these incidents need reporting at the highest level for investigation.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: ...It's just that, having been in the middle of everything, I'm struggling to keep an accurate perspective. I would appreciate if you could go through it all with me, so that I can reacquaint myself with the finer detail.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: So, where should we begin?
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: I think we already have the gist...
That we may, but as logical as things might seem, there are still many details about which we're uncertain.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: For example, how was the Stellaron brought onto the Xianzhou? And who sent it on to Scalegorge Waterscape? How many Disciples of Sanctus Medicus still remain at large? All of this is a mystery. Thus far, we've done our best.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: I'm submitting my written report to the Alliance, and I've already got a plan in mind. All of you will feature in the report, but for the sake of Jing Yuan, anything related to Xianzhou internal affairs will have names redacted — I hope you can forgive me.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: I was about to make the same request, Master Diviner. Since the Arbor's resurrection, I'm sure the Alliance will be poring over every detail of the report. I fear that if the Astral Express gets dragged into matters, leaving will not be an easy task.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Mm. Jing Yuan has committed quite a few violations this time around, and I'll have to deal with them one by one... *sigh* The Cloud Knight generals are all such a hassle.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Before you leave, please make time to recuperate. If there's anywhere you'd like to visit, feel free to take a look. I must attend to some Cloud Knight matters — farewell for now.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Oh — if you pass through Starskiff Haven, I have something that I hope you can give to Yukong.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Something Miss Tingyun left behind?
*sigh* It was all so chaotic. When Phantylia took form, it was as if Tingyun vanished into thin air.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: The Cloud Knights were only able to find her fan — she took it with her everywhere. It's currently unclear if Tingyun was a puppet manipulated by Phantylia, or if some form of deception was used to cloud our vision.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: I'm already prepared for the worst. Considering how the Legion operates, I fear the fate of the Sky-Faring Commission Amicassador may be a bleak one.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: As for how matters are handled with regards to Tingyun, I believe it's best left to her foxian kin. I have informed the Sky-Faring Commission of the events which took place, and I think it would be best if you were the one to deliver this item to Yukong.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: ...I understand. Leave it with us.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Thank you, Mr. Yang. Now, let me take a look at my remaining duties for the day. *sigh* It's quite the list...
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: It's getting late. If you need me, I'll be in the Divination Commission Conclave Hall.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Well, we had a lot of stumbles along the way, but we still managed to kick butt and save the Luofu without breaking a sweat. Feels kinda surreal.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Maybe this was all fate.
We're just mere puppets of the Stellaron Hunters...
[Trailblazer], you don't sound very happy.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Bah, no way! Everything good has come our way due to our hard work. I'm not letting them take any of the credit.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It may seem like the Stellaron Hunters are controlling everything, but we create our own future. No matter how powerful they are, they can't make a future that doesn't exist come true.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Since showing up, we've saved a lot of people and averted disaster for the whole Xianzhou. Who cares whether someone or something was directing it? Be happy, [Trailblazer]!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: What are your plans from here?
...Actually, I was wondering if Diviner Fu could do me a favor.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The Matrix of Prescience has amazing powers, and can iterate and reiterate Kafka's past... So it got me thinking — if I turned the Matrix on me, could it calculate my past?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Pretty smart.
Why didn't you ask Fu Xuan for help while she was here?
Hee-hee, yup! When you're free, let's head over to the Divination Commission together and ask them for a favor.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I was shy! Talking about personal stuff like that in front of everyone... it'd be too embarrassing!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: When you're free, let's go hit up the Divination Commission together and see what Fu Xuan has to say.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Things have come to a close for now. It's good that you came through unscathed.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Thanks for looking out for me, Mr. Yang.
What are we going to do next?
The master diviner asked us to pass on this item of Tingyun's. I'll go to the Palace of Astrum and meet with Yukong. If neither of you has anything urgent, it'd be best if you came too.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Returning to the Luofu and Scalegorge Waterscape... it's a surreal feeling.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I left so determined... Who would have thought that circumstances would draw me back once more?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: It's not like the Xianzhou has done anything to you... yet.
How long do you plan on staying here?
There are only a handful of individuals who know my identity now. I do not wish to guess what could occur if word gets out.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I'll be gone very soon. Jing Yuan is still recovering, and the Cloud Knights won't protect me anymore... It remains to be seen how the Six Charioteers will react to my presence.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: But at least for now, I'm safe.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: What are you going to do next?
I want to meet the current high elder of the Vidyadhara.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: It seems I won't be able to cast off Dan Feng's negative karma... so I'd like to learn more about his past. I want to find out what I can do to make up for his sins.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: If you're planning on an extended stay on the Luofu, I'm afraid I won't be able to join you. I'm sorry, [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I want to meet the current high elder of the Vidyadhara.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: If she can tell me more about Dan Feng's actions, then perhaps I can do something to make up for his sins.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I see. Please extend my regards to the Ten Lords...
rows.speaker: Yukong

rows.text: I will. Our condolences, Helm Master.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: You have guests. I shall take my leave.
rows.speaker: Xueyi

rows.text: Ahem... On behalf of the Sky-Faring Commission, I would like to thank the crew of the Express for saving the Luofu from the Stellaron crisis.
rows.speaker: Yukong

rows.text: Madam Yukong must have heard about Miss Tingyun...
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Yes, I have heard. Seeing four leave, yet only three return, was enough for me to know that Fu Xuan's report was indeed correct.
rows.speaker: Yukong

rows.text: Tingyun...
rows.speaker: Yukong

rows.text: I still can't believe it. The whole report reads like a bad joke — it's simply unimaginable.
rows.speaker: Yukong

rows.text: The Antimatter Legion on the Xianzhou? And Tingyun... a Lord Ravager?
rows.speaker: Yukong

rows.text: How could someone who spent over thirty years working alongside me at the Sky-Faring Commission... turn out to be nothing more than a monster in disguise? What happened to the real Tingyun?
rows.speaker: Yukong

rows.text: Madam Yukong...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I'm sorry... I understand... It's just hard for me to accept...
rows.speaker: Yukong

rows.text: *sigh* Thank you for bringing Tingyun's belongings back to the Palace of Astrum. The Stellaron crisis has cost us too many comrades, brothers, sisters... children.
rows.speaker: Yukong

rows.text: I'd like to invite all of you, as witnesses to this war, to a soul-soothing ceremony hosted by the Sky-Faring Commission. Will you consider?
rows.speaker: Yukong

rows.text: A "soul-soothing ceremony"?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: To put it into short-life terms — a funeral. You see, for long-life species of the Xianzhou, death has always been a distant, mystical concept.
rows.speaker: Yukong

rows.text: Ordinarily, the Ten-Lords Commission guides people to the Hall of Karma before any symptoms of mara are detected. There, they leave behind their lives and wait for their time to come. People are used to a short "farewell" as opposed to a tedious "burial" process.
rows.speaker: Yukong

rows.text: Given our limited life spans, the only ones who place value on ceremony are us foxians.
rows.speaker: Yukong

rows.text: Countless Cloud Knights lost their lives or became mara-struck during the crisis. The Hall of Karma couldn't take them all in, and so they passed away.
rows.speaker: Yukong

rows.text: All of these sudden deaths and unfulfilled wishes remind us... that long-life species still live out insignificant and limited lives.
rows.speaker: Yukong

rows.text: By combining Sky-Faring Commission technology with foxian ceremony, we honor those who have passed on. We place items of the dead onto starskiffs, and send them out to sail between the stars — to shine brightly among them.
rows.speaker: Yukong

rows.text: It's not just to comfort the dead — those souls who can never talk with us again — but also to comfort their surviving relatives, close friends, and indeed all residents of the Xianzhou...
rows.speaker: Yukong

rows.text: It's also my way of saying farewell to Tingyun. I know, I'm selfish. She may not have died a Cloud Knight, but she's still one of us here at the Sky-Faring Commission — a victim caught up in a wider conflict.
rows.speaker: Yukong

rows.text: I'd like to hold this ceremony as a way of distancing the memory of Tingyun from the Lord Ravager who tarnished her identity.
rows.speaker: Yukong

rows.text: I... can still hardly believe it. I'll use my own methods to locate Tingyun's whereabouts, but at present... I...
rows.speaker: Yukong

rows.text: This is the least I can do for her.
rows.speaker: Yukong

rows.text: I'd like to ask you all to witness this event with me.
rows.speaker: Yukong

rows.text: How can we help?
We'll be there at the ceremony.
I've instructed Yanming to sort through Tingyun's belongings. I hope you can pick some out to place around the starskiff.
rows.speaker: Yukong

rows.text: Leave this to us, we'll take care of it as per your wishes, Madam Yukong.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Once again, my thanks to all of you. I've asked the judges of the Ten-Lords Commission to ratify this soul-soothing ceremony, and have commissioned a special skiff at Stargazer Navalia for the ceremony. If you need anything, that's where I'll be.
rows.speaker: Yukong

rows.text: Tingyun prepared gifts for others, too? That's just like her...
rows.speaker: Yukong

rows.text: I want to take a look in that box...
I want to take a look at that knife...
I want to take a look at that bow...
You always did say that I liked to gossip, and here I am rambling on proving you right again... If only you were here to cut me off...
rows.speaker: Yanming

rows.text: There's nothing else... except a handful of seeds.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: It looks like there's something printed on the bottom of the box... The Sleepless Earl. Let me think — where have I seen that name before?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: I can't cook to save my life, but one thing I'm sure of is: That's a kitchen knife.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I've never seen Miss Tingyun use anything like that to defend herself... It must be another gift that she never had time to send.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: There's an ad in the knife case: "Spices Supreme," Aurum Alley? Which store is that again?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: This bow...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: March plucks the bowstring.
It's a good bow. It couldn't be meant for me... could it?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Think again...
I'm sure you weren't the only archer she knew.
Alright, just kidding. Just trying to liven things up around here.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ...Or you could just cut yourself off?
Mr. Yanming?
We're here on a gift-giving errand for Miss Tingyun...
Oh! It's you... For a moment I thought she'd returned... Did the Helm Master send you over?
rows.speaker: Yanming

rows.text: We're here to help sort out Miss Tingyun's things. Madam Yukong wants to use some of them for her soul-soothing ceremony.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Well, I've managed to get through pretty much everything — it's all in this box. Please, take your time.
rows.speaker: Yanming

rows.text: Okay, let's see what there is.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: An Amicassador's seal, a small box... a knife? A bow, and something wrapped up tight... I wonder what this is.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: She's had to embark on another long voyage...
I'm afraid Miss Tingyun is...
...Yes. Now that the crisis has been averted and the ports are resuming operations, Miss Tingyun has been dispatched on business with the Sky-Faring Commission... out to other worlds.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Oh, really? That's a shame. Well... hold on a sec.
rows.speaker: Mengming

rows.text: A few moments later, Mengming serves the tea she brewed.
Based on her suggestion, I improved the Whale-Tide Spring, Emerald Hills, and Dawndew strains to make a new variety with a sweet, long-lasting taste. I called it "Tingyun's Blend."
rows.speaker: Mengming

rows.text: Seeing as she can't enjoy it right now, I'll have to invite all of you to try a cup.
rows.speaker: Mengming

rows.text: You tell Mengming about what happened to Tingyun...
Miss Tingyun...
rows.speaker: Mengming

rows.text: We found this box of seeds among her belongings. I'm sure Miss Tingyun would have liked for you to have it.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: ...Thank you, all of you. I think... I should gift something to Tingyun in return.
rows.speaker: Mengming

rows.text: A few moments later, Mengming serves the tea she brewed.
Based on her suggestion, I improved the Whale-Tide Spring, Emerald Hills, and Dawndew strains to make a new variety with a sweet, long-lasting taste. I called it "Tingyun's Blend."
rows.speaker: Mengming

rows.text: Seeing as Tingyun won't be able to try it... we should drink a cup to her memory.
rows.speaker: Mengming

rows.text: I'm sorry you won't be able to try this tea, Miss Tingyun...
rows.speaker: Mengming

rows.text: I can't wait for Miss Tingyun to try this tea!
rows.speaker: Mengming

rows.text: [Trailblazer], how's it going? Did you take some time off? See any more of the Xianzhou?
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: Have you heard of Spices Supreme?
Isn't that the place on Aurum Alley over in Exalting Sanctum? All the foodies go there. What about it? Planning on treating me to a feast?
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: Looks like some kind of antique? But who'd want to hold on to something like this...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Oh, Tingyun explained that one to me. It's a folk statuette from foxian antiquity. They say it can bring wealth if placed correctly.
rows.speaker: Yanming

rows.text: There's also a note in the package: "This is for you, Mr. Yanming. Wishing you fortune and success in every endeavor." Yanming, it seems like this is a gift for you from Miss Tingyun.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I... I remember asking her for one at the time... Ahem, this is unexpected. I only mentioned it in passing, but she remembered.
rows.speaker: Yanming

rows.text: Whenever I'm tired of celestial jade or slacking off, I head over for a bowl of Granny Chen's Tofu. Darn it, now that you've brought it up, I suddenly don't feel like clocking in for work anymore.
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: [Trailblazer], how's it going? Did you take some time off? See any more of the Xianzhou?
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: Have you heard of Spices Supreme?
Isn't that the place on Aurum Alley over in Exalting Sanctum? All the foodies go there. What about it? Planning on treating me to a feast?
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: Tourists fresh off the starskiff always head to Starwatcher Avenue in Starskiff Haven — it's one of those bustling tourist streets... but if you want the real deal on local snacks, you gotta get to Aurum Alley. I've marked it out for you on your map.
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: Whenever I'm tired of celestial jade or slacking off, I head over for a bowl of Granny Chen's Tofu. Darn it, now that you've brought it up, I suddenly don't feel like clocking in for work anymore.
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: ...Tingyun and I were from different guilds. We were competitors... but also colleagues.
rows.speaker: Yanming

rows.text: We're here on a gift-giving errand for Miss Tingyun...
When we used to trade in other lands, we would bring back local specialties and distribute them among friends and other guild members — it became a custom.
rows.speaker: Yanming

rows.text: The rivalry between us and Whistling Flames to be the Sky-Faring Commission's top guild was always fierce. We would gift each other all kinds of bizarre oddities: Candy that made your leg hair grow, a violin that could shatter glass with its piercing shriek...
rows.speaker: Yanming

rows.text: *sigh* ...I was completely unprepared for this. I never thought Tingyun would leave something behind for me that was so sincere and earnest.
rows.speaker: Yanming

rows.text: If I don't return a gift, I'll lose our little duel... But what could I possibly gift her back?
rows.speaker: Yanming

rows.text: Huh, besides the seal, the knife, and the bow... None of this seems like something Miss Tingyun would've kept. I thought she was more about jewelry and beauty.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Could there be other things similar to what Yanming got? We should take a look.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: We should get going.
Indeed.
Actually... Tingyun...
Miss Tingyun couldn't tear herself away from work, so we've had to gift this on her behalf today.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Really, thank you so much. Why don't I give you all a demonstration and prepare a dish? My treat — I'd love to repay this kindness.
rows.speaker: Yancui

rows.text: Yancui goes into the back kitchen and brings out a steaming bowl of food.

Speaking of which, it was our Chili Beef Offal Stew that first attracted Miss Tingyun to our restaurant, hehe. It's spicy, sumptuous, and guaranteed to get the mouth watering. Not even a girl as refined as Tingyun could resist the temptation.
rows.speaker: Yancui

rows.text: You tell Yancui a brief account of what happened to Tingyun...
This... This is real, right...?
rows.speaker: Yancui

rows.text: The monster you mentioned... where did it come from? ...I wish—I wish I could take this knife and cut it to ribbons...
rows.speaker: Yancui

rows.text: *sigh* Forget it... matters like these are beyond the control and understanding of a cook like me... Thank you, all of you. Let me prepare a dish for you... as a gift for Miss Tingyun.
rows.speaker: Yancui

rows.text: Yancui goes into the back kitchen and brings out a steaming bowl of food.
It was our Chili Oil Beef Offal Stew that first attracted Miss Tingyun to our restaurant... I can't believe that she'll never taste it again. Please, you'll have to eat her share too.
rows.speaker: Yancui

rows.text: If only Miss Tingyun could try this one last time...
rows.speaker: Yancui

rows.text: It's a shame Miss Tingyun's too busy today...
rows.speaker: Yancui

rows.text: Do you know where we're supposed to take these things, [Trailblazer]?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Thank you for helping her complete all these tasks. She can depart in peace.
rows.speaker: Yukong

rows.text: We're still preparing the starskiff for the ceremony. Please, everyone, come back to me when your work is complete.
rows.speaker: Yukong

rows.text: I heard Tingyun prepared gifts for others, too? That's just like her...
rows.speaker: Yukong

rows.text: Thank you for helping her complete all these tasks. She can depart in peace.
rows.speaker: Yukong

rows.text: We're still preparing the starskiff for the ceremony. Please, everyone, come back to me when your work is complete.
rows.speaker: Yukong

rows.text: Welcome to the Sleepless Earl! I'm the owner here — the name's Mengming. How many of you are there? Which tea would you like today?
rows.speaker: Mengming

rows.text: Oh! This is... This is the tea Miss Tingyun promised to get for me! She really went to another world for this? She's incredible.
rows.speaker: Mengming

rows.text: When I took over this teahouse from my parents, I thought I'd shake things up by creating a new tea product.
rows.speaker: Mengming

rows.text: Famous brews like Whale-Tide Spring or Vegetations in the Alchemy Cauldron have been around for millennia, and imported mixed teas have also found a niche. Introducing a new product into the industry is really hard.
rows.speaker: Mengming

rows.text: Miss Tingyun came to the teahouse one day and heard about my troubles — she said she could find me a brand-new strain during her travels — one that nobody on the Xianzhou had ever tasted.
rows.speaker: Mengming

rows.text: I just thought she was trying to cheer me up — I never thought she'd actually do it... Where is Miss Tingyun today?
rows.speaker: Mengming

rows.text: Aurum Alley?
Go on...
It's the main commercial street in the Exalting Sanctum, although it's a lot quieter since the whole Stellaron crisis thing.
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: Tourists fresh off the starskiff always head to Starwatcher Avenue in Starskiff Haven — it's one of those bustling tourist streets... But, if you want the real deal on local snacks, you've gotta get to Aurum Alley. I've marked it out for you on your map.
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: Honored guests, welcome to our humble eatery! What can we get for you today?
rows.speaker: Yancui

rows.text: Something from Miss Tingyun for me...?
rows.speaker: Yancui

rows.text: Hahaha, what a precious person she is. A sweet thing like her, gifting me a kitchen knife.
rows.speaker: Yancui

rows.text: When she first ate here, I told her my motto: "You can't better your own food unless you taste it." Then she got me to talk about my hunting and cooking experiences out on other worlds.
rows.speaker: Yancui

rows.text: She was captivated — she pestered me about dish after dish... At the end, she mentioned she wanted to get me a gift: "A sword for a hero, and a knife for a chef" — that's how she put it.
rows.speaker: Yancui

rows.text: She probably came across some rare mineral and forged it by hand. Look how sharp it is! I bet it'd cut straight through a Thalassa Titanium Terrapin shell.
rows.speaker: Yancui

rows.text: *sigh* Miss Tingyun is too kind. Who among the Aurum Alley vendors hasn't been spoiled by the generosity of Whistling Flames? Her Grand Fair puts small merchants like us in touch with big intergalactic vendors. If we're talking gifts, it's us who should be gifting her something.
rows.speaker: Yancui

rows.text: I heard the trade port is open again for business. Miss Tingyun must be real busy, right?
rows.speaker: Yancui

rows.text: About that bow — I think I know who Miss Tingyun intended to gift it to.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Mister Yanming said an Amicassador will return with a gift for a trusted colleague...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Soon, the starskiff will carry the items you selected to the stars unknown, vanishing in the vastness of their halo.
Long-life or short-life, everyone sails towards the same destination.
The person who Tingyun trusts the most is Madam Yukong, right?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: This bow... Did Tingyun pick it out for me? She understood my pain — it's a shame I can no longer do anything for her...
rows.speaker: Yukong

rows.text: The starskiff is ready for the ceremony now. Everyone, please place your objects aboard the starskiff.
rows.speaker: Yukong

rows.text: W—Wait! Wait for me!
Miss Tingyun prepared a gift for me. As a fellow Amicassador, I cannot fail to honor our custom...
rows.speaker: Yanming

rows.text: Yanming, what is it that you've prepared?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I... I've brought a paper kite. I know it may seem simple compared to the precious items that Tingyun gifted others in the past... but it has a deeper meaning.
rows.speaker: Yanming

rows.text: I heard that foxians have a tradition where paper kites are used to comfort the souls of pilots who can no longer take to the skies. Tingyun and I were never pilots in the strictest sense of the word... but we spent much of our lives out among the stars.
rows.speaker: Yanming

rows.text: For her to be able to take wing once again... would make her very happy.
rows.speaker: Yanming

rows.text: [Trailblazer], out of all this stuff we've got, what do you think we should place on the starskiff?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The Amicassador's seal
Thank you for everything you've done for the Sky-Faring Commission and the Luofu. This small seal is the foundation of the Xianzhou's prosperity.
rows.speaker: Yukong

rows.text: The tea named after her
This is the tea that Mengming has made, especially named after you.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Hmm? [Trailblazer], did you forget that we already drank that back at the teahouse?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Her favorite dish
This is a gift from Miss Yancui on behalf of all the restaurants on Aurum Alley. You are going to love this.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Uh, you already ate that, remember? I can't just get you another one now, can I?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The soul-soothing paper kite
This time, we needn't compete. Go, fly on to other distant worlds.
rows.speaker: Yanming

rows.text: The Sky-Faring Commission shall never forget you, Tingyun. I will seek out the truth, and if it is discovered that you were taken from us, I swear to avenge your unjust end.
rows.speaker: Yukong

rows.text: It is time for the soul-soothing ceremony. Please make your way to Earthrise Agora in Starskiff Haven.
rows.speaker: Yukong

rows.text: General, the ceremony has finished. You should take a rest.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Not yet. I have things I wish to convey to my Astral friends.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: My apologies, I couldn't get to you any sooner — Yanqing made sure that I was fully recuperated...
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Before you leave the Luofu, there are two things I wish to gift the Express.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Two gifts? Has his conscience finally gotten the better of him? Is he going to make up for all our hard work along the way?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You're too kind, General!
I'd like some free real estate, please!
Please, let us reconvene at the Seat of Divine Foresight.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: I once held the same ceremony on the Fanghu, some thirty years or so ago now. Painful memories don't ever fade away with time, and I don't want to bear witness to those scenes again.
rows.speaker: Yukong

rows.text: Once I've finished handling the various tasks at hand, I want to aid the Cloud Knights in their investigation. I'll fly out on a starskiff and trace Tingyun's original flight path onto the Xianzhou. Rest assured, I will leave no stone unturned.
rows.speaker: Yukong

rows.text: Present company is gathered to reiterate the Xianzhou Luofu's esteemed gratitude for the magnanimous actions of the Nameless.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: I am sure Lady Fu has given voice to this already, but the Luofu is greatly indebted to you. Therefore, on behalf of the Luofu Cloud Knights, I hereby present you with a jade abacus — a symbol of our allied friendship.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: A jade abacus?
Is this a souvenir?
It... could indeed be considered a souvenir of a certain variety. But not one you could find in a gift store.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Back when the Alliance was first established — all those thousands of years ago — the Xianzhou ships swore an oath, etching the record into a jade abacus. The world may crumble and the heavens may fall, but this oath shall never be broken.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: The same is true of this jade abacus — it is a record of the Luofu Cloud Knights' promise to the crew of the Astral Express. It is also a beacon — grip it tightly, and it will send a message to the jade abacus here in my hand.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: No matter how astronomically distant you are, the Luofu Cloud Knights will always come to the aid of the Crew, whatever your need may be.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Wow, now that's what I call a pay-off.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Ahem... Of course, I trust that such an important article will not be used for trivial or inappropriate circumstances. I hope you can understand...
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Yup, got it. Say no more. Sure thing.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Thank you for your generosity, General.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Dan Heng.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: General...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: In accordance with the edict of the Ten-Lords Commission, I am hereby authorized to relieve your banishment decree. From this day henceforth, you may come and go freely on the Luofu...
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Nice!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Nice!
Not a complete surprise.

...But I must remind you that the crimes of Dan Feng have had far-reaching implications... and some people, such as those in Scalegorge Waterscape, will not be much moved by the issuance of a paper edict.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: While I can guarantee your freedom to come and go as you please, I cannot guarantee your safety. Again, I hope you can understand.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: I understand.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The Express' records show that Penacony was a prison planet used by the IPC to exile criminals... At least, it was at the time of recording.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: However, following a {RUBY_B#Cancer of All Worlds}Stellaron{RUBY_E#} burst, the planet fell into the arms of {RUBY_B#the Harmony}Xipe{RUBY_E#}. They say it's been transformed into a prosperous and ethereal realm.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: This issuing of gifts brings with it a sense of relief... Even my wound is feeling much improved. The occasion calls for a line or two of poetry... though I feel my efforts would be overshadowed by the erudition of Lady Fu. Another time, perhaps.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: The Express' records show that Penacony was a prison planet used by the IPC to exile criminals... At least, it was at the time of recording.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: However, following a {RUBY_B#Cancer of All Worlds}Stellaron{RUBY_E#} burst, the planet fell into the arms of {RUBY_B#the Harmony}Xipe{RUBY_E#}. They say it's been transformed into a prosperous and ethereal realm.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: The Express and its passengers have a long voyage ahead of them. May that voyage be smooth and untrammeled. I bid you Farewell.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: When the conductor is ready, we can set off for the next stop.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Himeko messaged me — the Express detected the Jade Gate's re-opening. She asked whether we'd be heading back any time soon.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: When the conductor is ready, we can set off for the next stop.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I'm leaving the Luofu.
She was also asking after you, Dan Heng. I think it'd be best for you to update her in person, don't you think?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: She must have been worried. I'll return to the train and put her mind at rest.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Himeko must be eager to hear about what we've been up to on this mission too, right?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Uh, hang on. How could I forget. We should bring something back for the conductor. [Trailblazer], have you got any unfinished business on the Xianzhou?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: After fighting Dan Heng, I feel like my skills are lacking somewhere. If you have any time to coach me...
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: I think Dan Heng is a better match for you...
We could schedule in a couple of rounds...
I'm worried that he still holds some grudge against me. But to be honest, I'd love to have another spar with him.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Deal.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Safe travels.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: I'd like to visit some of the friends we made along the way...
I'm leaving the Luofu.
Uhh... don't think so...
Oh yeah, there are some people we haven't said goodbye to yet!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I'm leaving the Luofu.
Even if I do return, this is still a farewell, right?
...Is that really everything you want to say?
I've got goldfish memory — we haven't had a chance to say goodbye to everyone we met so far on this trip.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Fine, fine. Dan Heng and I will go back to the Express. The two of you come back soon, okay?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Don't worry, Mr. Yang.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I'm leaving the Luofu.
When I left the train, I only had time to say a quick goodbye to Himeko.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I should go back and give her an update... and thank her for her guidance.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: We've been so busy running around in circles, we haven't gotten the chance to say goodbye to friends we've just met — I feel like parting is still such sweet sorrow.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Who should I go to first? The Master Diviner? Qingque? The miracle doctor? Or what about Master Gongshu? *sigh* [Trailblazer], shall we go and meet them all?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Oh hi, I know we haven't got the chance to get acquainted, but I've heard a lot of good things about the crew from the general. I have to say I'm very impressed.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: So soon?
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: *sigh* I wanted to help the general, but things didn't turn out how I wanted them to be. I've learned my lesson.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: Also, I have a rather abrupt request.
rows.speaker: Yanqing

rows.text: *sigh* What do we do now? We don't really have to turn over a new leaf, do we?
rows.speaker: Arrogant Kid

rows.text: I'm leaving the Luofu.
Is that it? I thought you were gonna stay for at least a little longer...
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: Did Welt learn how to play celestial jade in the end...? If he hasn't got the hang of it yet, tell him to come see me and I'll show him the ropes.
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: Oh, I haven't asked you yet — are you interested in learning yourself?
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: Sure, if it's easy to learn.
Uhh... I'll pass.
Aha, I thought so. Come back when you have time — I'll teach you.
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: C'mon... If you learned how to play, then you, Welt, and March would only need to find one more person! You could get a table going and play a few rounds during your travels.
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: We're in agreement then. You can come back any time and I'll teach you how to play.
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: No way. We pretend to obey the grownups, then get back to business as soon as we get the chance!
rows.speaker: Mean Kid

rows.text: Hey, what are you looking at? This is our conversation, okay? Hmm... Why does this outworlder seem so familiar to me?
rows.speaker: Arrogant Kid

rows.text: I remember now! Last time we dealt with this one we got into big trouble!
rows.speaker: Mean Kid

rows.text: Ah, it's you! You're the one who betrayed us, right?
rows.speaker: Arrogant Kid

rows.text: We've been ordered to change our name from "The Luofu Trio" to "The Luofu Study Club..." It's so embarrassing! Now no-one's gonna respect us anymore...
rows.speaker: Arrogant Kid

rows.text: So tell us — how much compensation are you gonna give?
rows.speaker: Mean Kid

rows.text: I'm planning on leaving the Luofu.
Huh? Trying to flee?
rows.speaker: Arrogant Kid

rows.text: I'm leaving the Luofu.
*sigh* Boss, let's just forget about it. Let this bad omen off the Luofu so we can get on with business.
rows.speaker: Mean Kid

rows.text: Just go then, what's it gotta do with us? You think we're friends or something? You wanna say goodbye to us?
rows.speaker: Hateful Kid

rows.text: Dan Shu asked me to bring you a message.
Dan Shu? Who's Dan Shu?
rows.speaker: Arrogant Kid

rows.text: She's the leader of the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus — the one everyone was talking about!
rows.speaker: Mean Kid

rows.text: *gulp* Sanctus... Medicus? Wh—wh—what do you want with me?
rows.speaker: Arrogant Kid

rows.text: I'm leaving the Luofu.
You want us to join you or something?
rows.speaker: Hateful Kid

rows.text: Stay away from Xiaoyu, y'hear? Otherwise...
Y—You guys must think you're pretty tough, bullying kids like us out in the open.
rows.speaker: Arrogant Kid

rows.text: I'm leaving the Luofu.
For a youngster to deliver a farewell to an old man like me is a rare occurrence in this day and age.
rows.speaker: Master Gongshu

rows.text: *sigh* I've taken on many a short-life apprentice — after leaving the Luofu, they never return. Time, not distance, is the true separator of souls.
rows.speaker: Master Gongshu

rows.text: The lingering sound of bygone music plays, though groweth fainter with the parting ways.
rows.speaker: Master Gongshu

rows.text: Don't worry. I'll be back.
You sound touched, Master Gongshu.
I'm glad. I'll still be here at the Artisanship Commission. You're welcome any time.
rows.speaker: Master Gongshu

rows.text: Life is full of farewells, and I've seen more than most.
rows.speaker: Master Gongshu

rows.text: *sigh* But farewell it is. I shall not sing for you on your way out... I fear the sound would break my heartstrings...
rows.speaker: Master Gongshu

rows.text: Woof woof!
rows.speaker: Diting

rows.text: I'm leaving the Luofu.
Have us arrested then.
Time to throw in the towel boss — they're playing for real. If you wanna start a fight with the Disciples, I'm out.
rows.speaker: Mean Kid

rows.text: Ugh, guess you're right, these guys mean business. My mom said they eat three or four kids for breakfast!
rows.speaker: Hateful Kid

rows.text: Y—Yeah... Ahem! Hey, you — we promise not to bully Xiaoyu again, if you promise not to mess with us.
rows.speaker: Arrogant Kid

rows.text: And don't bully any other kids, either.
Diting lifts its front paws, draws an arch in the air with its round head, turns around, and runs off into the distance.
It looks like he has something to show you.
Woof woof!
rows.speaker: Diting

rows.text: That depends on your end of the bargain.
O—O—Okay, we promise! But you have to keep your word too!
rows.speaker: Arrogant Kid

rows.text: Diting circles around and sits down, expectantly wanting to see you open the chest and get something nice.
Then as the Luofu Trio, we...
rows.speaker: Hateful Kid

rows.text: Shh! We're the Luofu Study Club now! Don't say anything about the Trio. You ought to be more afraid of the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus!
rows.speaker: Arrogant Kid

rows.text: Good thinking, Boss! Long live the Luofu Study Club!
rows.speaker: Mean Kid

rows.text: Is that you, {F#big sister}{M#big brother}?
rows.speaker: Xiaoyu

rows.text: I knew it was you by the sound of your footsteps.
rows.speaker: Xiaoyu

rows.text: It's me. I'm planning on leaving the Luofu.
You're leaving?
rows.speaker: Xiaoyu

rows.text: Thank you for helping me... and thanks to Dan Shu too. I should be taller the next time you're back, so I won't be such a burden on everyone.
rows.speaker: Xiaoyu

rows.text: By the way, is Dan Shu okay? Me and my friends are worried about her... We haven't heard from her since the last time she delivered the medicine.
rows.speaker: Xiaoyu

rows.text: She's... on sabbatical studying medicinal pellets.
She's dead.
Oh, I understand. Making pellets must be very hard work — we shouldn't bug her.
rows.speaker: Xiaoyu

rows.text: When I grow up, I want to be a great alchemist like Dan Shu — making medicine and helping the incomplete ones!
rows.speaker: Xiaoyu

rows.text: Well... bye-bye, {F#big sister}{M#big brother}. Have a safe journey!
rows.speaker: Xiaoyu

rows.text: Dead... What does "dead" mean? Does it mean, going to a really really really far away place forever and ever, and never coming back? Like my mommy and daddy?
rows.speaker: Xiaoyu

rows.text: That's one way of putting it...
She committed a serious crime... and was executed on the spot.
So... Dan Shu will never come to see us again?
rows.speaker: Xiaoyu

rows.text: The little girl stares in your direction in silence, but the look in her eyes says a lot.
Thanks for telling me, {F#big sister}{M#big brother}. Like Dan Shu always said, we can't expect others to take care of us forever.
rows.speaker: Xiaoyu

rows.text: Goodbye, {F#big sister}{M#big brother}.
rows.speaker: Xiaoyu

rows.text: Hello, [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Bailu

rows.text: ...To start your next journey... That's great. *sigh* I can't wait to escape the Commission again...
rows.speaker: Bailu

rows.text: Oh, make sure you come visit! Next time you're here, we'll put my plan into action...
rows.speaker: Bailu

rows.text: Hey boss, I recognize {F#her}{M#him}! {F#She's}{M#He's} the one who messed with us last time!
rows.speaker: Hateful Kid

rows.text: I've got it all figured out. We sneak out, head over to Aurum Alley, and pig out on the snacks there!
rows.speaker: Bailu

rows.text: ...Or I could just go there myself.
Better start planning that escape route then.
...Hmph, I know all the best places, — you'll be lost without me.
rows.speaker: Bailu

rows.text: Mm-hmm, it's a deal.
rows.speaker: Bailu

rows.text: Aaaand don't forget to come see me if you get any headaches, fever, tendon pain, joint pain — anything! My treatment is on the house!
rows.speaker: Bailu

rows.text: I'm guessing seeing you here probably means your affairs on the Xianzhou are mostly complete?
rows.speaker: Qingque

rows.text: [Trailblazer], are you off then?
rows.speaker: Yukong

rows.text: The Xianzhou Luofu is all the richer for your brief time with us. I offer blessings on behalf of the Sky-Faring Commission, on the eve of your departure.
rows.speaker: Yukong

rows.text: If you require resupplying during your journey, you can always count on us.
rows.speaker: Yukong

rows.text: Hi?
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Are you listening to Mr. Xiyan's stories?
Sure am. Things have been in constant turmoil since I transferred to the Luofu. Now that I've got a little free time, I'm here to listen to some storytelling.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Are you... Sorry, I've met so many people recently, you seem unfamiliar... Judging by your clothes, you must be an outworlder?
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Dan Heng told me all about...
I'm Dan Heng's friend...
Ahh, I see! Silent But Deadly told me something about meeting up with a friend. You must be them?
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: ...Silent But Deadly?
Mm-hmm, pretty accurate nickname, right? That guy has a lot on his plate — it's enough to make you worry.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: The fact you're standing here right now must mean things are pretty much taken care of?
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Is that so? Well, before you leave, I recommend listening to Mr. Xiyan's Legend of the High-Cloud Quintet.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: Ever since I was a little kid, I've always wanted to be an epic hero... I never get tired of hearing about the Quintet — I'm sure you'll love it.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: You should bring Dan Heng along next time, we can chat over some tea. Anyway, I'm getting off-track, I won't take any more of your time. Good luck.
rows.speaker: Sushang

rows.text: *whimpers*
rows.speaker: Diting

rows.text: Rrr—ruff ruff woof! Woof woof!
rows.speaker: Diting

rows.text: The second half of Luofu's jade abacus of allying oath. It takes on the shape of a tiger — not sure if this detail carries any significance.
A symbol of friendship bestowed by the Xianzhou Luofu. As valuable as the gift is, you were secretly hoping that they'd gave each of you a manor in Exalting Sanctum.

According to Jing Yuan, holding the jade abacus firmly in your hand will send out a message to the Cloud Knights and they will rush to your aid. It's difficult to resist the temptation of giving it a try right now.
Looking at the plain color of jade and patina, it's easy to think that such an item is of no particular value. But the golden inlay points to its noble origin.
The things Miss Tingyun left behind have finally found their homes.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It's time to go back to Stargazer Navalia and see Madam Yukong.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: I... don't understand...
What's that? You're gonna miss me?
Woof woof! Rr—ruff!
rows.speaker: Diting

rows.text: Generalship is no trifling matter — how could I be "enjoying myself?" All I can do is get used to it, hmph...
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Generalship is no trifling matter — it is a duty one must bear.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Is this... a gift for me!?
Woof~
rows.speaker: Diting

rows.text: I guess a dog really is a man's best friend after all.
Some time later, you arrive at the Seat of Divine Foresight to check on Jing Yuan...
Thank you!
Woof!
rows.speaker: Diting

rows.text: The Artisanship Commission has come through hell and high water since the incident. Rebuilding what we lost will drain the years, our labor filled with blood, and sweat, and tears!
rows.speaker: Master Gongshu

rows.text: Are you here to say goodbye?
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: There's no need to be so anxious. I predict that you will return to the Xianzhou often, and you will definitely continue to trouble us when you do.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: (I think she's enjoying herself...)
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: (I think she actually really enjoys it...)
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Therefore, forget about any farewells.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: Alright, okay, I understand.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: I wish your travels be fleeting of foot, and may your crises be effortlessly resolved.
rows.speaker: Fu Xuan

rows.text: There's a dreamlike quality to watching these starskiffs depart through the Jade Gate. How long will these ships sail, and which stars are they traveling to?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: From a universal perspective, there is little difference between the lives of long and short-life species. The transcendence that the Xianzhou pursues is nothing compared to the enduring majesty of the stars. And the grief felt here... is no different from our own.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Didn't know you were a poet, Mr. Yang.
Sorry to interrupt the poetry...
You're back, [Trailblazer]. Himeko and I were just discussing our journey.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: This little excursion has reached its conclusion — all things must come to an end. Still, some endings spark a new beginning.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: [Trailblazer], you're back. Welt was telling me about your experiences — I'm more than a little envious! The Ambrosial Arbor, the Ebon Deer, the Divination Commission Matrix, Scalegorge Waterscape...
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I pestered Dan Heng to tell me about his experiences, but alas, what could've been a magnificent saga was reduced to a few words and a grunt.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Next time, I think I should be the one trailblazing with you guys — Welt can stay on the Express.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: ...Since when did the work roster just change like that?
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: What's our next stop?
So, we can warp jump as planned this time?
Penacony. Do you remember? Before Kafka's proposal, that was our original destination.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Yes. No more Stellaron Hunter interruptions — it's time to get our original plan back on track. Our next stop is Penacony, remember?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: The Family is throwing a banquet there, and they sent invitations to the Express. I was curious about what was happening there, so I accepted.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Penacony is throwing a banquet — I've received an invitation from The Family.
rows.speaker: Himeko
